description: This PHP file generates a web page for voice debug global parameters configuration and control. It includes HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and PHP code to display, retrieve, and set voice diagnostic settings such as SIP client status and console log level. The file also includes server-side functions and client-side scripts for user interaction and AJAX communication.

methods.name: Dm_data_get
methods.description: Retrieves current voice diagnostic global parameters such as logging level and SIP process status.
